---
title: "Ellwood Canyon Ranch"
format: html
---

Here is an interactive map that shows the most important parts of the ranch.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Paste your published "Map Data" CSV link here
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSRQyyi-2Q3gxQikQDZqdzLAaamvRB4iILP3CLFdYiOIShpZ97p3eymEeTmxvs_XLqAXPff7Fj2lIoQ/pub?gid=1300473115&single=true&output=csv"
ranch_data <- read_csv(sheet_url)

# 2. Format the interactive popup windows
ranch_data <- ranch_data %>% 
  mutate(popup_content = paste0(
    "<div style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 220px;'>",
    "<h4 style='margin: 0 0 5px 0; color: #2E5A27;'>", title, "</h4>",
    "<p style='font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 8px 0; line-height: 1.4;'>", description, "</p>",
    "<img src='", image, "' style='width: 100%; border-radius: 4px;'>",
    "</div>"
  ))

# 3. Build and center the map
leaflet(data = ranch_data) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$USGS.USImageryTopo) %>% # Satellite + Topo lines combo
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, 
    lat = ~lat, 
    popup = ~popup_content, 
    label = ~title
  )
```
